the_rule: the headline number is the MARGIN over the best control, not the accuracy. A model with 80% accuracy and 78% on the blank knows nothing; one with 62% and 50% on both controls knows something. A teacher is usable at a margin of 0.10 or more.
limits: one labelled session per condition is not a benchmark; a model can score by memorising a session's look rather than its motion
the shuffled control destroys temporal order but keeps spatial layout, so a teacher that passes it is genuinely reading motion
the blank control catches a teacher that answers from the prompt
a passing teacher still does not license training a student: the student is evaluated on held-out labelled sessions, which is a separate measurement
